content: MK argues that the controversy over Ibn ʿArabī's pantheistic influence, in which Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī and Zayn al-Dīn Tāybādī were prominent opponents, explains why Ṣāʾin al-Dīn was persecuted by Zayn al-Dīn Khwāfī and his circle: as a promoter of Ibn ʿArabī's theory he could not fail to arouse their ire (MK: 'not an accident').
refers_to_primary: MK, citing Bashir, Sufi Bodies, 98-99; Knysh
